text_block_list.text:
A few months after I began sensing 
something was wrong with my body. —At 
last, that moment arrived.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, regarding tomorrow's training 
menu...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?
(Thud...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "Trainer! ...An, an ambulance...!"

The next time I woke up, all I saw was the 
ceiling of a hospital room. After that, 
they ran various tests over several days, 
but—

As expected, no abnormalities were found 
anywhere. And yet... I had a strange 
certainty.
choice_data_list:
(If things keep going like this... I'm 
going to break.)

text_block_list.text:
However, what is truly terrifying is— 
feeling absolutely no fear toward it at 
all.

If my body can just hold out through the 
year... I can see Still in Love through 
her precious three years. I can support 
her...
choice_data_list: (――If it breaks after that, so be it.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list:
...Thank you, you came to pick me up, 
didn't you.
...Thank you, you came to pick me up, huh.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Matching.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: You too—are the same color.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Crimson... Crimson, like blood...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Just as it is. If only you could... dye 
everything.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: We can be together forever.

Happiness oozes from her. The girl before 
my eyes is no longer... ordinary. And 
then...—
I, too, long ago.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Heheheh... ♪ Heheh... heh... 
heheheh... ♪

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Just a little more. Just a little bit 
more, and...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: A beast, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Do you think you've become the ruler of 
the night or something...?"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I don't feel anything. Not anymore... not 
from you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Her prime is long behind her. And the love 
she once monopolized—has been rewritten.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Withered flowers have no flavor. Chewing 
on them is nothing but a waste.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —An irritating cry.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
As you are now, you are merely a beast of 
pure narcissism... With no overlapping 
circles.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Filled as I am with absolute love, you 
could never hope to beat me.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
You think you're better than me? Heh, 
really now...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Want to try it out?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Tch, well then, please head to the 
starting gate. I'll get a taste of how you 
are right now."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufufufu!! Hey――how does it feel to be the 
one being chased!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Foolish. Your love――falls short.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Heh... Haaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaa♡ So this is your love— —Mejiro 
Ramonu...nnngh!!"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
The more I drink you in... the sweeter you 
taste. Fufu... fufufu...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, what should we do next? Where shall 
we compete against each other?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Dull gray.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The color of your love. Can you see it 
clearly?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Falling while knowing, and falling without 
knowing... are two entirely different 
things.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Even your innocent heart is dyed 
crimson... Where are you heading?"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: You too—are the same color.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Just as it is. If only you could... dye 
everything.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: We can be together forever.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: D-Don't tell me... —Is this my fault?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Because I... surrendered myself to 
instinct... did it end up affecting even 
that person?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Was I... ...actually happy about that...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Pitiful beast.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Even though I could never be like that.

—Late at night. Thinking I couldn't sleep 
anyway, I kept working in my room. Having 
grown used to this lifestyle, I don't even 
feel fatigued anymore...
choice_data_list:
(Ah, whatever... it doesn't even matter 
anymore)

text_block_list.text: Come here.
Help me.
—Come here.
Help

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...!? T-Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...! I'm so sorry...!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, it's all my fault... You're 
going to... break...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I knew it... I should have just ended it 
back then...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I can't... run anymore—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaaaaaagh!! Uuuuugh...!!

Her anguish was beyond ordinary. A scream 
that felt as though her heart and body 
were being torn apart—

I desperately held her back as she lost 
control. I didn't know what was happening, 
but I knew the root of her pain. In that 
case—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: *pant*... ah...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?!

—My heart aches as if it's being crushed 
in a fist.

As if to stop the words I was about to 
say. However... If I don't tell her—she 
will only suffer more.
That's why—
choice_data_list: "K e e p r u n n i n g"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: Your running is my joy. Run.
Your running is my joy. So run.

text_block_list.text:
—...No. That's not it...! That's not what 
I wanted to say! And yet, the words coming 
out of my mouth are—
choice_data_list:
Let me be your support. From now on, 
always.
Let me support you. Now and always.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I am fine. ...I understand now.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(I've realized it now. That there's... no 
turning back.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (Because—you are already captive.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Without me even realizing it. 
Irreversibly... so deeply, so deeply...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(If torn away by force... ――it would break 
my heart entirely.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"There's no going back to how I was before 
being tainted... The only salvation 
left—is just one..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, I'm okay now. Let's head 
back... before morning comes."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: For us, it was far too dazzling—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Please, give me just a little more 
time.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Just a little more. Please let me run... 
just a little longer.
choice_data_list: But if you do that, then you'll—
But if you do that, then you'll—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I'm fine. ...I have to devote it to you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
The supreme victory... that will satisfy a 
starved soul...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: After that—
